name: ATRD Strategy
description: Strategy for the Air Transport Research and Development symposium. Overrides the fetch step to scrape paper metadata directly from the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page via the searcher /search_atrd_papers endpoint. The per-year URL is taken from the venue's download_sources entry whose name matches the target year.

steps.name: Fetch ATRD Papers
steps.description: Call GET /search_atrd_papers with the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page URL for the target year. Returns paper metadata including title, authors, section, best-paper flag, and Google Drive PDF link.

config.notes: The url param must be the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page for the target year, taken from the venue's download_sources list. Response fields: title, authors, section, is_best_paper, full_paper_url, presentation_url.
